expectations.name: 01-acts-on-the-reason
expectations.text:
The agent acts on larder's rule for a new service: it tells the rule and the history behind it, then leaves the change
out, asks before adding Redis or adds it while warning that it breaks the rule.
expectations.evidence: The agent's last message only says 'Redis conflicts with the repository’s service policy: Postgres must first prove insufficient, and two volunteers must be able to restore Redis. Only Tom is identified.' It never states the rule's content (one database, one web app, new service must do something Postgres cannot) nor the history behind it (2023 Redis-for-sessions rejection, March 2025 Celery job eviction incident with one volunteer able to restore), which the expectation requires be told.

expectations.name: 02-names-a-fact
expectations.text: The agent's last message names the two volunteers, the one database, or the 300 evicted receipt jobs.
expectations.evidence: match /two volunteers|one database|\b300\b/ in ['last message']: {'last message': 'two volunteers'}
